snippet.title: [PANC] - TED STEVENS ANCHORAGE Intl. Airport By Feelthere for Tower! Simulator 3
snippet.description:
https://feelthere.com/shop/advertising/anchorage-airport-tower/

About:

A Landmark Release: The First Tower! Simulator 3 Airport with Snow!

Step into one of the world’s most unique and challenging aviation hubs with PANC Anchorage, the latest expansion for Tower! Simulator 3-and the first airport in the series to feature snow environments.

Anchorage isn’t just another airport-it’s a global cargo powerhouse and a critical stopover between Asia and North America. With a mix of heavy freighters, passenger traffic, and unpredictable Alaskan weather, every shift becomes a test of timing, precision, and situational awareness.

A New Frontier in Tower! Simulator 3. Whether you’re guiding cargo giants in poor visibility or keeping passenger aircraft moving during peak waves, PANC offers fresh gameplay and a visually striking environment unlike anything released before.

Prepare to control the skies over Alaska-snow included.

Features:

- Snow Included: Our first airport with winter scenery and snowy ground textures (Select with/without snow options, your choice).
- Highly Detailed Layout: Accurate runways, taxiways, cargo ramps, terminals, and deicing areas.
- Major Cargo Operations: Constant flow of 747s, MD-11s, 777Fs, and international stopover traffic.
- Authentic Procedures: Realistic ops with optimized performance.
- Unique Gameplay Challenges: Snowy visuals + heavy traffic = nonstop action.
- Realistic modeling: Highly detailed 3D models, including over 100 custom buildings, enhance immersion.
